newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Fayetteville State University, NC.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Fayetteville State University, NC.

text.p: Dining System Facility Fee Revenue Bonds, Series 1997

The Board of Governors of the University of North Carolina SEALED BIDS will be received by the Board of Governors of the University of North Carolina (the Board'') at the General Administration Building, The University of North Carolina, 910 Raleigh Road, Chapel Hill, North Carolina, until 10:00 A.M., local North Carolina time on

at which time and place said bids will be publicly opened and read, for the purchase, at not less than 99% of par, of not less than all of the Fayetteville State University Dining System Facility Fee Revenue Bonds, Series 1997 (the Bonds''). The Bonds will be issued as fully registered bonds without coupons in denominations of $5,000 and whole multiples thereof. The Bonds will be dated their date of issuance and will bear interest payable semiannually on the 1st day of each January and July, commencing July 1, 1997. Interest on the Bonds will be calculated on the basis of a 360-day year consisting of twelve 30-day months. The Bonds will mature annually on January 1 in the years and amounts set forth in the official Notice of Sale and the Preliminary Official Statement relating to the Bonds.
The approving opinions of Smith Debnam Hibbert, L.L.P., Raleigh, North Carolina, and Hunton & Williams, Raleigh, North Carolina, co-Bond Counsel, will be furnished to the purchaser without cost.

Copies of the Preliminary Official Statement and the official Notice of Sale and Bid Form relating to the Bonds may be obtained upon request from Dr. Harry J. Ghee, Vice Chancellor for Business and Finance (Acting), Fayetteville State University, C.J. Barber Administration Building, Room 117, 1200 Murchison Road, Fayetteville, North Carolina 28301-4298, (910) 486-1151, or from J. Lee Peeler & Company, a Division of Morgan Keegan & Company, Inc., Investment Bankers, 3100 Tower Boulevard, Suite 404, Durham, North Carolina 27707, (919) 419-2500.
